nodes.summary: Let $L'$ and $L$ be subgroups of an abelian group $A$. If $L'$ is a cyclic sublattice of $L$, then the quotient group $L/L'$ is cyclic.
nodes.title: The quotient by a cyclic sublattice is cyclic

nodes.summary: Let $L'$ and $L$ be subgroups of an abelian group $A$. Then $L'$ is a cyclic sublattice of $L$ if and only if $L' \subseteq L$ and the quotient group $L/(L' \cap L)$, with $L' \cap L$ regarded as a subgroup of $L$, is cyclic.
nodes.title: Characterization of cyclic sublattices

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an abelian group and let $L'$ and $L$ be subgroups of $A$. Then $L'$ is a cyclic sublattice of $L$ when $L' \subseteq L$ and the quotient group $L/L'$ is cyclic; formally the quotient is taken by $L' \cap L$, regarded as a subgroup of $L$.
nodes.title: Cyclic sublattice of a subgroup

nodes.summary: Let $L'$ and $L$ be subgroups of an abelian group $A$. If $L'$ is a cyclic sublattice of $L$, then $L' \subseteq L$.
nodes.title: A cyclic sublattice is contained in its ambient subgroup

nodes.summary: Let $L'$ and $L$ be subgroups of an abelian group $A$. If $L' \subseteq L$ and the quotient group $L/L'$ is cyclic, then $L'$ is a cyclic sublattice of $L$.
nodes.title: Criterion for a cyclic sublattice

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
